description: This file defines classes and functions for JSON serialization and deserialization in a Flask application, including customizable JSON providers and response handling.

classes.name: JSONProvider
classes.description: Base class for JSON operations, allowing customization of JSON serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: DefaultJSONProvider
classes.description: Subclass of JSONProvider that uses Python's built-in json library and serializes additional data types.

methods.name: dumps
methods.description: Serialize data as JSON to a string, with default parameters set for the JSON library.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serialize data as JSON and write to a file.

methods.name: loads
methods.description: Deserialize data from a JSON string or bytes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserialize data from a file object.

methods.name: _prepare_response_obj
methods.description: Prepare the object to be serialized in the response, handling args and kwargs.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Serialize arguments as JSON and return a Flask Response object with application/json mimetype.
